class BITMAP is
    width: int
    height: int

    _pixels: LIST[ubyte]

    init(width: int, height: int) is
        self.width = width
        self.height = height

        _pixels =
            (0..width * height * 3) |> map(_ => 0ub) |> collect_list()
    si

    fill(colour: COLOUR) is
        for at in 0..width * height do
            _write(at, colour)
        od
    si

    set_pixel(x: int, y: int, colour: COLOUR) is
        _write(y * width + x, colour)
    si

    pixel(x: int, y: int) -> COLOUR =>
        (let at = (y * width + x) * 3

         (red = _pixels[at],
          green = _pixels[at + 1],
          blue = _pixels[at + 2]))

    _write(at: int, colour: COLOUR) is
        _pixels[at * 3] = colour.red
        _pixels[at * 3 + 1] = colour.green
        _pixels[at * 3 + 2] = colour.blue
    si
si

    si
